name: Broccoli & Smoked Sausage Cheddar Bake

fit.note: Clears the gate on numbers (400-650 cal, <=35g carbs, scalable to 14 by weigh-and-divide, no seafood) - rejected purely as a duplicate, not for fit.

reason: Same dinner on all four identity axes as the already-accepted baked-cauliflower-mac-smoked-sausage: main protein (smoked sausage), sauce/flavor family (cheddar + cream-cheese sauce), base (a low-carb cruciferous floret standing in for the starch), and method (oven bake). The only differences are the specific floret (cauliflower->broccoli) and minor seasoning/binder (cajun+heavy cream vs garlic+mayo) - a floret swap inside an identical cheesy smoked-sausage bake, not a distinct plate.
cross_protein_twins: keto-turkey-broccoli-cheddar-casserole (accepted, turkey) - structurally the same broccoli+cheddar low-carb casserole in turkey; my candidate is the pork-sausage restatement of it
cheesy-smoked-sausage-rice-skillet (catalog, turkey) - same smoked-sausage+broccoli+cheddar flavor but rice-based skillet, so a different dinner, not a dupe
pool_note: The pork-sausage lane is carrying a large near-identical cluster of smoked-sausage + cruciferous-floret + cheddar low-carb bakes (both broccoli and cauliflower variants, some egg-enriched). Other adjudicators are ruling these; decider should collapse the whole cluster to a single survivor - baked-cauliflower-mac-smoked-sausage already holds that slot.
